title: the installer names its box through the system device's host tool
intention: The installer names its box through the system device's host tool: cairn/devices/recovery/machines/installer/installer.py:134; cairn/devices/recovery/machines/installer/installer.py:182 read the host from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host and nowhere else, so this component names its box on every OS.
why: Akien, 2026-11-21, relayed by akiendelllinux_cc_orchestrator: "hostname should come from the system device." Folded into outline 6.6.3.7 and 2.3.7.1.5 (branch akiendelllinux/host-door-outline, 97b4ce0b7). Measured 2026-11-21: cairn/devices/recovery/machines/installer/installer.py:134 (ask_cairn_home: platform.node().split('.')[0]); cairn/devices/recovery/machines/installer/installer.py:182 (ask_box_identity: platform.node().split('.')[0]) spell the host by hand, so a box with no os.uname (Windows) or a nodename the roster does not spell breaks here. Child of spanning ticket a577fd03e307 (one door names the host). Ticket 5ccc7f05c932 (READY c9824d056 on branch akiendelllinux/5ccc-host-door) builds the door, cairn/devices/system_rackmount/tools/host/host.py; this build starts after it lands on main, because the tool does not exist on main before then.
traces_to: Outline 6.6.3.7 (the hostname comes from the system device); outline 2.3.7.1.5 (the system device's host tool is one of the client tools a device publishes, the named exception to 2.3.7; a CC by-line builds, 0.4.1); outline 17.26.1 (a published client tool lives with its device); RULE 1 (the system device's public interface is the tool it publishes); Law 1 (one answer, not N re-derivations of it).
how: Both `hostname or platform.node()...` defaults become `hostname or host_name()` with a lazy import from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host; the explicit hostname= parameter stays. ask_box_identity names the TLS identity from `me` (tls.make_identity(d, me)), and host_name() lowercases it; the dry_run tooth never makes an identity.

clauses.claim: an AST scan of cairn/devices/recovery/machines/installer/installer.py finds no call to os.uname, platform.node, platform.uname or socket.gethostname, and every host name those files read comes from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host.host_name

with os.uname deleted, CAIRN_HOME_HOST absent from the environment, rc a scratch file and ask_text_fn recording its prompt and answering 'x', ask_cairn_home() returns status 'skipped' and its first prompt names host_name(); the scratch rc is unchanged

with os.uname deleted and a scratch tls_dir, ask_box_identity(dry_run=True, home=host_name().upper() + '.lan') reports the home's held asks (not attaching), and ask_box_identity(dry_run=True, home='testing-rec-other-box') reports first contact with testing-rec-other-box

decisions.text: D1 (clause 1): both `hostname or platform.node()` defaults (installer.py:134, :182) become `hostname or host_name()` with a lazy import from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host, `import platform` dropped; tooth test_it_asks_the_os_no_hostname scans the file's AST.

D2 (clause 2): tooth test_the_installer_names_its_box_with_os_uname_gone runs ask_cairn_home over a scratch rc with CAIRN_HOME_HOST unset and an asker answering 'x', os.uname deleted and platform._uname_cache cleared before and after.

D3 (clause 3): tooth test_the_box_identity_knows_its_home_with_os_uname_gone runs ask_box_identity(dry_run=True) over a scratch tls_dir for host_name().upper()+'.lan' and for testing-rec-other-box; dry_run makes no identity.

out: every other component's host sites (siblings under a577fd03e307)
OS-family checks (platform.system, sys.platform, os.name): outline 6.6.3.7 claims the hostname only

measured.how: grep -rnE 'os\.uname\(\)|platform\.node\(\)|socket\.gethostname\(\)|platform\.uname\(\)' over cairn/ skills/ bin/ on branch akiendelllinux/5ccc-host-door (c9824d056)

measured.saw: clause 2 and 3 passes against the unbuilt code on Linux: deleting os.uname in-process cannot red it, because platform.node() falls back to socket.gethostname() there, so on this box it is a hollow green that measures nothing
measured.how: the new proof run in this ticket's worktree with the code file put back to HEAD's bytes, bin/cairn test --exec, akiendelllinux (akiendelllinux_cc_0)

builder_notes: BEFORE PROVED: akiendell_cc_0 runs this ticket's proof natively on Windows (os.uname absent there) once it is relaunched, and records that verdict on this ticket; it is clause 2 and 3's real measurement (orchestrator, 2026-11-21)
